summary: the netcfg_io, dhcpc, netup, ncport and httpd host tests with 23 faults in private copies of utils/netcfg.c, dhcpc.c, netup.c, nc.c and httpd.c; the test runs all five

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/t && mkdir -p ${WORK}/t/tests/host && cp -R utils ${WORK}/t/ && cp -R ${SRC}/. ${WORK}/t/ && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/utils -I tests/host/compat/netutil tests/host/netcfg_io_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/utils/ipcheck.c -o ${WORK}/netcfg_io_hosttest && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/utils -I tests/host/compat/netutil tests/host/dhcpc_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/utils/ipcheck.c ${WORK}/t/utils/dhcpmsg.c -o ${WORK}/dhcpc_hosttest && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/utils -I tests/host/compat/netutil tests/host/netup_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/utils/ipcheck.c ${WORK}/t/utils/netcfg.c -o ${WORK}/netup_hosttest && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/utils -I tests/host/compat/netutil tests/host/ncport_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/utils/ipcheck.c -o ${WORK}/ncport_hosttest && ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I ${WORK}/t/utils -I tests/host/compat/netutil tests/host/httpd_hosttest.c ${WORK}/t/utils/ipcheck.c -o ${WORK}/httpd_hosttest
s=0; for t in netcfg_io_hosttest dhcpc_hosttest netup_hosttest ncport_hosttest httpd_hosttest; do ${WORK}/$t || { r=$?; [ $s -ne 0 ] || s=$r; }; done; exit $s
